review_notes.evidence: Header.png final digit clipped at native right edge; lower vertical MA257 readable. Retained missing printed glyph unknown.
Focused BR designation shows surviving closed upper B counter, retained BR4; parity designation BA4 clear. AJ card Q1 confirmed separate focused crop.

All23 native gates and23 physical inputs separately read. Passive R T1 ports have no invented outputs. CE/BY/BZ input wedges only; remaining N inputs plain, ordinary outputs wedge except CE/BY/BZ plain. AD3365A1 and locationL3 confirmed focused crop.

SAB14 BH/BR; SAB17 AA/AB; SAB16 AJ/AK; SAB12 AC/AD; SAB19 CB/CC; SAB18 CD/BV; parity AZ/BA; SAB13 BQ/BX; SAB15 BJ/BS; LAB00 AE/AF. BR→BY,BS→BZ,BX→CE are separate negative physical outputs, crossings remain unjoined.

Native AK loop113/33→199/33→199/24 with diamond199,25 and BR183/31→198/31→198/28 with diamond198,29. BX negative branch161/19→161/32. Other source output diamonds and short continuation stubs individually retained.
